summary: Script is excellent—pure-stdlib Python, modular design, clear error handling. Workflow YAML is well-structured with proper permissions, matrix strategy, and job dependencies. However: (1) workflow_dispatch.version_file input (lines 17–20) is defined but never consumed; (2) validate job references fixtures/*/VERSION, fixtures/*/commits.txt, and release job references root commits.txt—none of these files appear in deliverable; (3) workflow cannot actually run without test fixture data. Code quality is high; deliverable is incomplete.
